name: Dawarich
short_desc: Self-hosted location history tracker, an alternative to Google Timeline
author: Freika
description: Dawarich is a self-hosted web app for storing and visualising your own location history. Import your Google Maps Timeline, Owntracks, Immich, Photoprism or GPX history, or have a phone app post points to it continuously, then browse the result on a map with heatmaps, routes and fog-of-war coverage. It works out the cities and countries you have visited, counts your points and distance per month and year, keeps a list of trips, and can suggest visits from clusters of points so you can confirm or rename them. Reverse geocoding can run against a geocoder you host yourself, so no part of your location history has to leave your server.

form_fields.label: Secret key base
form_fields.hint: Rails signs sessions and cookies with this. Required in production; changing it signs everyone out. Equivalent to `openssl rand -hex 64`.
